sentence: This project builds an app-based platform that gives early childhood teachers timely feedback on their talk during shared book reading.
This project improves how a network telescope collects, cleans and shares data about unsolicited and potentially malicious Internet traffic.
This project brings artificial intelligence, robotics and automation, and immersive technologies into modern construction practices.
This project studies how climate variation changes the behavior of four African large carnivore species and their predation and competition.
This project tries to improve the accuracy of dating methods that rely on the natural radioactive decay of potassium in rocks.
This project studies how compressibility affects turbulent mixing of fluids with large density variations.
This project develops catalysts using quantum mechanical modeling, machine learning and high throughput experimentation.
This project develops design practices, computing tools and computational methods to support early-stage medical device development and evaluation.
This project builds machine learning methods that combine scientific knowledge with data to model fluid dynamics, aerosols and lakes.
This project studies insect farming, including how insects turn waste into protein and the genetics behind their traits.
This project builds a modeling framework that predicts how processing conditions affect the interlaminar strength of carbon fiber-reinforced thermoplastic composites.
This project makes quantum metamaterials that manipulate light and designs electronic materials a few atoms thick using synthetic chemistry.
This project tries to use enzymes to make cell-sized capsules move and communicate with each other and with cells.
This project builds a mathematical framework based on Fourier analysis to find where the advantage of quantum computers comes from.
This project tests machine learning tools that use signals from consumer wearable devices to detect postpartum depression early in women who give birth.
This project creates certificate programs in bioinformatics and biotechnology.
This project builds models and algorithms that use citizen science data to infer where migratory bird populations travel.
